issues.title: [AI] Tich hop Gemini/Claude API
implementation_notes: Actual implementation: full RAG pipeline, not plain API call
pgvector extension installed on PostgreSQL 17 (v0.8.2)
KnowledgeBase table with vector(3072) embeddings, 24 gym knowledge documents seeded
Pipeline: gemini-embedding-001 -> cosine similarity search -> Gemini 2.0 Flash
Endpoints: POST /api/ai/chat, GET /api/ai/history, GET /api/ai/usage

issues.title: [AI] Gioi han AI usage theo membership
implementation_notes: Implemented within Issue #12 (checkAndUpdateUsage)
Enforces limits before every AI call; auto-resets daily/monthly counters
Error codes: AI_001 (no membership), AI_002 (daily limit), AI_003 (monthly limit)
Limits: Basic 1/day-10/month, Premium 10/day-100/month, Elite unlimited

Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (serif) + Inter (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono)
Axios client with JWT interceptors; Zustand auth store with persist middleware
